messages.operator: GLOBAL HALAL SUPPLY CHAIN LIMITED · HONG KONG
messages.boundary: AI/ML monitors, predicts and assists. Humans and competent authorities decide. AHTE does not independently create Halal certification, sovereign release, financing approval or Takaful decisions.
messages.architecture: Target architecture · production connections require authorized activation
messages.principle: Data stays where it belongs. Trust travels.

pages.label: The ecosystem
pages.title: Distinct roles. One accountable trust chain.
pages.description: GHSCL operates the international digital infrastructure; AHTE links evidence and trust; JAKIM remains the authority system; China origin connects directly to GCC destination.

sections.title: Who does what
cards: Perak State Government halal-industry GLC operating locally and internationally within the project ecosystem.
International operating and digital-infrastructure vehicle for China → GCC orchestration and 24/7 Command Center operations.
Continuous standards, evidence, compliance, traceability, predictive analytics and trust intelligence.
Competent-authority system and human authority workflow. The project target connection is direct JAKIM API connectivity.
Sources, suppliers, laboratories, manufacturers, warehouses, Sinotrans, ports and devices contribute attributable evidence.
Authorities, customs, importers, warehouses, distributors, retailers and buyers apply destination controls and acceptance.

sections.title: Direct JAKIM API is the project authority interface
sections.text: Public/project topology must not insert a generic intermediary between AHTE and JAKIM. Exact production endpoints, authentication, permissions and payload contracts remain source-locked until authorised.

sections.title: Connected does not mean collapsed
sections.text: PHC, GHSCL, AHTE, laboratories, Sinotrans, port/customs authorities, GCC authorities, financiers, Takaful operators and competent Halal authorities retain distinct responsibilities. Evidence, monitoring and cryptographic integrity do not create another party's decision.

pages.label: How it works
pages.title: Origin to market. Evidence to authority. Prediction to prevention.
pages.description: The operating lifecycle starts before manufacturing and continues through lab evidence, smart audit, direct JAKIM API authority workflow, Sinotrans, ports and GCC receiving.

sections.title: Before the factory
sections.text: A material remains bound to source, lot, sample, custody and laboratory evidence before production decisions are made.

sections.title: Factory control and smart audit
sections.text: ERP, MES, QMS, WMS, LIMS, IoT and human evidence are connected rather than replaced.

sections.title: Authority-linked trust
sections.text: Authority status and AHTE trust state remain separate records. A platform score cannot manufacture certification.

sections.title: China → GCC direct
sections.text: Malaysia is the governance/assurance plane unless a separate physical movement is explicitly scoped.

sections.title: 24/7 assurance
sections.text: The system aims to prevent integrity failures rather than only report them after the fact.

pages.label: AHTE digital trust
pages.title: Evidence graph. Digital twins. Hard gates. Accountable state.
pages.description: AHTE combines standards intelligence, digital twins, cryptographic integrity, AI/ML assurance, trust-state orchestration and direct authority connectivity.

sections.title: The intelligence layers
cards: Resolve instrument, version, requirement and scope before controls.
Bind source, actor, device, timestamp, custody and integrity proof to exact objects.
Find gaps, anomalies, contradictions and emerging risk; preserve model and evidence provenance.
Facility, material, sample, batch, pallet, shipment, container and seal objects carry identity, relationships and events.

sections.title: Integrity protects history; it does not create truth
sections.text: Trust also depends on source, actor, custody, scope and accountable review.

sections.title: Certification, trust and release are separate
cards: Evidence/control state of an object or transaction.
Separate internal gate after required conditions pass.

sections.title: Replaceable connectors with explicit boundaries
cards: Evidence/status exchange without inventing official endpoints.
Sample, custody, method, result and amendment/versioning.
Warehouse, logistics, custody, telemetry, container and seal events.
Authorised trust lookup plus sovereign inspection/hold/release event return.

sections.title: Target extension objects
sections.text: Command-center alerts, prediction objects, preemptive strategies and finance evidence packets are first-class post-freeze proposal objects. They cannot create authority, credit or underwriting decisions.

pages.label: 24/7 Command Center
pages.title: Monitor now. Predict next. Intervene before failure.
pages.description: GHSCL and authorised JAKIM-side roles monitor the ecosystem through AHTE analytics, alerts, predictive models and preemptive strategy workflows.

sections.title: A first-class operating plane
sections.text: The Command Center is not a passive dashboard. It coordinates continuous monitoring, exception ownership, escalation, intervention, CAPA, re-verification and recall readiness.

sections.title: 24/7 monitored domains
cards: Supplier, material, manufacturer, HCP/SCCP and smart-audit state.
Sample/custody pipeline, method/result integrity and evidence status.
Warehouse, logistics, container, seal, telemetry, route and custody.
Origin/destination port status, inspection, release, receiving and downstream distribution.
Evidence expiry, authority-status synchronization and trust fractures.
Forecasts, blast radius and preemptive strategy recommendations.

sections.title: Decision-class boundaries remain enforced
sections.text: AI/ML can assess, prioritize and support configured D4 holds. It cannot bypass D5/D6 authority decisions or silently release a human-reserved hold.

pages.label: End-to-end traceability
pages.title: Four synchronized chains from origin to market.
pages.description: Physical movement, identity/custody, evidence and authority/trust state remain linked from source material to GCC destination.

sections.title: Origin and genealogy
sections.text: Source → producer → supplier → material lot → sample → laboratory evidence → manufacturing batch → packaging lot.

sections.title: Every event has a digital binding
sections.text: ObjectID + EventID + EvidenceID + ActorID + Timestamp + IntegrityProof, with source system, control, requirement, device and relationship references.

sections.title: Traceability without unrestricted disclosure
sections.text: Role, organization, purpose and jurisdiction determine what manufacturers, auditors, authorities, logistics operators, importers and consumers can see.

pages.label: Smart-glass AI audit
pages.title: At the physical site. Bound to requirement and evidence.
pages.description: Wearable auditing links object identification, observations, evidence capture, AI assistance, human findings and re-verification.

sections.title: The complete audit session
sections.text: AI assists. The auditor owns the finding. Formal certification remains with the competent authority.

sections.title: Offline evidence remains attributable
sections.text: Local event hash → server validation → sequence reconciliation → signature check → commit → acknowledgement.

pages.label: China → GCC corridor
pages.title: Direct physical corridor. Malaysia governance and assurance.
pages.description: Shipment 001 is the first controlled proof-of-execution model linking China origin, Sinotrans, ports and GCC destination through continuous evidence.

sections.title: Default physical route
sections.text: Do not describe the default Shipment 001 route as China → Malaysia → GCC.

sections.title: Sinotrans is warehouse + end-to-end logistics
sections.text: The target integration covers WMS/TMS/Y2T/MIS/EDI/IoT, booking, pickup, warehouse receipt/dispatch, segregation/storage, pallet/lot, container/seal, telemetry, route/geofence, custody, port transfer and proof of delivery.

sections.title: Port/customs authorities receive an API/trust interface
sections.text: The interface supports minimum-necessary shipment trust resolution and sovereign inspection/sampling/hold/release event return. AHTE does not override port/customs authority.

sections.title: Shipment 001 remains a pilot until real evidence exists
sections.text: Architecture and simulations do not instantiate a shipment. Real entity, product, buyer/importer, batch, authority, lab, logistics and destination evidence are required.

pages.label: Ecosystem partners
pages.title: Each participant owns its mandate and evidence.
pages.description: AHTE connects institutions, manufacturers, laboratories, logistics, ports, financiers and destination actors without collapsing their legal or operational authority.

sections.title: Operating participants
cards: International operating/digital infrastructure and Command Center function.
Facility, product, formula, process and production evidence.
Import, receiving, distribution and market acceptance.

sections.title: Finance and Takaful are separate decision domains
sections.text: AHTE may provide authorised evidence packets; banks/financiers and Takaful operators retain their own decisions.

pages.label: Manufacturers
pages.title: A scalable onboarding factory for complete Halal/Tayyib readiness.
pages.description: Manufacturer onboarding binds enterprise, facility, product, formula, raw materials, suppliers, systems, controls, laboratory evidence, smart audit and destination readiness.

sections.title: Integrate existing factory systems
sections.text: AHTE connects ERP, MES, QMS, WMS, LIMS, IoT, DMS and identity systems rather than replacing them solely to join the trust ecosystem.

sections.title: Applicability drives controls
sections.text: Entity, product, process, activity, destination and organization profile determine standards/instruments, HAS/IHCS profile, HCP/SCCP and expected evidence.

pages.label: Shariah finance & Takaful
pages.title: Trust evidence can support finance without becoming the finance decision.
pages.description: The target Shariah Financing API supports trade finance, Takaful evidence and tokenomics/digital-value mechanisms subject to separate Shariah, legal and regulatory approval.

sections.title: Target services
cards: Evidence support for Islamic trade finance and purchase/order finance.
Asset, custody, shipment and exception-state evidence.
Underwriting and claims evidence support; decisions remain external.
Digital-value support only where legal, regulatory and Shariah structures approve it.

sections.title: Hard boundaries
sections.text: AHTE trust state is not a credit decision. Halal certification is not financing approval. Tokenization does not by itself change ownership, legal title, regulatory status or Shariah status.

pages.label: Verify
pages.title: Resolve an issuer-authorized disclosure, not a public database dump.
pages.description: Verification exposes the minimum authorised product, batch, shipment, evidence and status information without converting a token lookup into certification.

sections.title: Verification is scoped disclosure
sections.text: The verification service resolves issuer-authorized disclosure tokens. It does not infer certification from a product ID, hash or QR code.

sections.title: A hash proves integrity relative to a digest, not truth
sections.text: Verification also depends on trusted issuer identity, signature/key validity, evidence provenance, authority references and scope.

pages.label: Contact / onboarding
pages.title: Enter the ecosystem through the correct workstream.
pages.description: Prepare a manufacturer, laboratory, logistics, authority, destination or finance/Takaful engagement without sending credentials or confidential evidence through the public site.

sections.title: Primary workstreams
cards: Enterprise, facility, product, evidence and market readiness.
Warehouse, transport, telemetry, container, seal and custody integration.
Authorised trust-resolution and sovereign event interface.
Direct JAKIM API target integration subject to authorised production contract.

sections.title: Do not submit secrets on the public site
sections.text: Credentials, private keys, identity documents and confidential evidence belong in authenticated controlled channels.
